exposure: Infants born at term, preterm infants
cohort: 393 EoE cases in Denmark (birth years 1997-2018) and 3,659 population controls
finding: Preterm birth, NICU admission, pregnancy complications, and being very growth restricted at birth were associated with the development of EoE in a Danish population.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with EoE.
followup_time: Median age at index date: 11 years (interquartile range, 6-15)
